description: String escaping: only the quote, the backslash and control characters below U+0020 are escaped (\b, \t, \n, \f, \r by name, the rest as lower-case \u00xx); every other character, DEL, U+2028 and non-ASCII included, is written as itself in UTF-8, whatever escape the input used. The first value is RFC 8785 section 3.2.2's.
